'''Felusia Stato''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A merchant like her relatives [[Meridat Stato|Meridat]], [[Nelva Stato|Nelva]], and [[Clem Stato|Clem]], Felusia Stato sold furniture and decorations.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
A Decorations vendor who can be placed in players' Strongholds, Felusia Stato was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the [[2014]] Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds|''Galactic Strongholds'']]. She is identical to the vendor Nelva Stato, who is found on [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="TOR" />
